name: Nebula

abilityDetails.Shock: Zamanla elektrik tabanlı şok hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Power Lock: Hedefin herhangi bir yolla güç kazanmasını engeller.

signatureAbility:
Firmware Refactoring
While the opponent is suffering from at least 1 Shock Debuff, Nebula's attacks gain +[8 - 25]% Combat Power Rate.
immunityDetails:
• Kanama Bağışıklığı 🩸
• Zehir Bağışıklığı 🧪

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: Advanced Robotics provides full Immunity to Bleed, Poison and Shock effects.

abilitySections.title: Self-Repair
content: Nebula begins each fight with 3 indefinite Self-Repair Charges. When she runs out, she will gain another after 10 seconds.

Each time the opponent deals more than 110% of their Attack Rating in a single hit, Nebula will spend 1 charge to gain a Self-Repair Buff, recovering the damage dealt over 5 seconds. If Stunned while Self-Repair is active, it is lost.
Self-Repair and its Charges are Immune to Ability Accuracy reductions.

abilitySections.title: Shock Debuffs
content: Unless otherwise stated, Nebula's Shock Debuffs inflict [1,871.1] Energy Damage over 6 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Amp Charges
content: While holding Block, Nebula builds up 1 Amp Charge every 0.65 seconds. Each time an Immunity prevents a Shock effect on Nebula, gain 5 Amp Charges. Max Stacks: 20.
Each Amp Charge reduces the opponent's Ability Accuracy by 20% if they are a #Robot.
Perform a Well-Timed Block: Convert all Amp Charges into Shock Debuffs on the opponent.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: 100% chance to inflict a Shock Debuff.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: 100% chance to inflict a Power Lock Debuff lasting 1 second(s) per Shock Debuff on the opponent.
100% chance to inflict Power Drain, depleting 12% of a bar of Power per Shock Debuff on the opponent.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: Nebula removes all personal Shock effects on the opponent. For each Shock removed this way, she inflicts 2 Shock Debuffs each dealing [3,326.4] Energy Damage over 3 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Nebula gains a Weapon Overcharge Passive lasting 25 seconds.
While Active, Nebula has a 65% chance to gain an Amp Charge when making Contact with the Opponent.
While active, any contact with the opponent has a 75% chance to inflict a Shock Debuff.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Firmware Refactoring
content: While the opponent is suffering from at least 1 Shock Debuff, Nebula's attacks gain +[8 - 25]% Combat Power Rate.
